WITH ssr AS (
  SELECT s_store_id,
         sum(sales_price) AS sales,
         sum(profit) AS profit,
         sum(return_amt) AS returns,
         sum(net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           CAST(ss_ext_sales_price AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(ss_net_profit AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM store_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
           sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
           CAST(sr_return_amt AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(sr_net_loss AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns
  ) AS salesreturns
  JOIN store ON salesreturns.store_sk = store.s_store_sk
  WHERE salesreturns.date_sk IN (
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim AS dd
    WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
  )
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
         sum(sales_price) AS sales,
         sum(profit) AS profit,
         sum(return_amt) AS returns,
         sum(net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           CAST(cs_ext_sales_price AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(cs_net_profit AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
           cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
           CAST(cr_return_amount AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(cr_net_loss AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
  ) AS salesreturns
  JOIN catalog_page ON salesreturns.page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
  WHERE salesreturns.date_sk IN (
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim AS dd
    WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
  )
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT web_site_id,
         sum(sales_price) AS sales,
         sum(profit) AS profit,
         sum(return_amt) AS returns,
         sum(net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM (
    SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           CAST(ws_ext_sales_price AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(ws_net_profit AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM web_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
           wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales_price,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
           CAST(wr_return_amt AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(wr_net_loss AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns
    LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales
      ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)
  ) AS salesreturns
  JOIN web_site ON salesreturns.wsr_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
  WHERE salesreturns.date_sk IN (
    SELECT dd.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim AS dd
    WHERE dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
  )
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       sum(sales) AS sales,
       sum(returns) AS returns,
       sum(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || s_store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
